Name: Day 1 Pet and Farm Cave
Author: silvermoonchan
Description:
[size=4]Tired of waiting for Marnie and Demetrius? Annoyed when they interrupt your workflow? Yeah me too. [/size]

[size=4]This mod edits the pet question and cave question to be asked the first time you leave your farmhouse after meeting Marnie and Demetrius respectively, so it's out of the way immediately. No mess, no fuss.[/size]

[size=4]You only need SMAPI and Content Patcher for this one. Just download and install as usual.[/size]

[size=4]Enjoy![/size]
